lines.differs: Tougher on AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: Payment is due within 30 days of invoice instead of 45 days, and invoicing requires milestone acceptance.
Tougher on AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: Invoicing requires formal milestone acceptance rather than just milestone completion, though payment remains 30 days.
Tougher on AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: Invoicing is tied to milestone acceptance rather than completion, and total build fees are $45,000 versus $33,000.
Tougher on AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: Applies to reasons "attributable to AtliQ" instead of "solely attributable", despite the same 0.5% weekly and 5% cap.
Broadly like Sunrise Foods: Penalizes delivery milestone delays at 0.5% per week up to 5%, rather than monthly support service level failures.
Easier for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: 0.5% per week of delayed milestone capped at 5%, versus 1% per day of total contract value uncapped.
